errors.what: Initial relative-path clan read and ls calls failed with 'No such file or directory' because the bash cwd resets between calls and was not the clan repo root
errors.recovered_by: Re-ran all clan commands with cwd set to the absolute clan repo root so the repo-relative paths resolved

context_understood: I merged the finance-modeler's 3-year TCO findings (Zoho saves ~EUR17,280 with a 7-month payback, Finance leans Zoho) into the shared data-only CRM-recommendation doc as a patch, then validated and snapshotted hop 8.
